claims.text: The share of reviews from new players increased to 22.38% during the window, coinciding with a free weekend.
Review volume increased significantly during the window, with 2252 reviews compared to 1288 in the baseline period.
Negative reviews mentioning performance issues rose by 5.3 percentage points in the window.
Negative reviews regarding gameplay balance increased by 6.81 percentage points.
Negative reviews mentioning story and world design increased by 8.83 percentage points.

findings.title: Price and free weekend impact on review volume and sentiment

report.summary: Review volume rose to 2252 reviews compared to 1288 in the baseline period. Negative reviews mentioning performance issues rose by 5.3 percentage points, gameplay balance increased by 6.81 percentage points, and story and world design increased by 8.83 percentage points. The share of reviews from new players increased to 22.38 percent during the window, coinciding with a free weekend. A price change or sale is supported. Noise or seasonality is rejected. The patch, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and a change in who reviewed are inconclusive.
